snippet.title: Azhar Erriad: Hamzaoui Is Missing! - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
-Welcome to Azhar Erriad School, You are a new student at Azhar Erriad School, where nothing is quite as it seems. Your arrival coincides with the mysterious disappearance of Hamzaoui. Explore the school, meet its quirky students, and unravel the secrets hidden in the school.

-Game Page:https://volbox-interactive.itch.io/azhar-erriad-hamzaoui-is-missing
